generatedAt.description: When this profile last changed, not when it was last checked

repo.description: Canonical GitHub repository key: lowercase owner/name

sources.description: Where the census found it (curated lists, searches)

categoryHint.description: The research sheet's Workflow Part, until enrichment assigns categories

docs.description: Languages the README is written in, by share of text

docsAlternates.description: Languages of other READMEs the README links to, e.g. 'en' for README_EN.md

ui.description: Locale folders shipped in the .xpi (BCP 47 tags)

chineseOnlyDocs.description: README in Chinese only, with no linked translation

chineseOnlyUi.description: The only interface locales shipped are Chinese

supports.description: Zotero majors the manifest range covers; none for a file Zotero won't install

next.description: Next major on the beta/dev channel

blockedByZotero.description: This version is on Zotero's official plugin blocklist

autoUpdates.description: The manifest has a working update address, so Zotero updates the plugin

builds.description: The release's other analysed builds, e.g. for older Zotero or another OS

updates.description: Where Zotero gets updates for this build, which replace the analysed file

repo.description: owner/name when the address is on a code host

project.description: The listed project updates come from

check.description: The update address fetched and followed to the file it offers

status.description: HTTP status of the update address; 0 when unreachable

result.description: What Zotero would install from it today: this file, a different one, nothing

finalUrl.description: Where the update address redirected, e.g. a renamed repository

ownerMissing.description: The GitHub account or repository the address names doesn't exist or isn't public

missing.description: account: nobody holds the name, so anyone could register it; repository: the account exists, so only its owner could publish there

zoteroVersion.description: The Zotero version the address was checked for: current Zotero, or the newest one this build supports

sha256.description: The file the update installs, once downloaded

statedHash.description: The hash the update address gives for that file (update_hash), e.g. 'sha512:…'

hashMatches.description: Whether the file behind the link has the stated hash; when it doesn't, Zotero refuses the update

manifestModifiedAt.description: When the update address's file last changed (its Last-Modified), set when the hash doesn't match: a release file uploaded after it isn't the file it was written for

label.description: Overall label of that file when it differs from this one

error.description: Why the offered file couldn't be analysed

note.description: One line for the card's update line

releaseFile.description: Path of the per-version analysis document, relative to data/generated/

fork.description: Set when the repo is a GitHub fork of another listed plugin

addonIdSharedWith.description: Other listed plugins shipping the same add-on ID; Zotero can only install one

inputHash.description: Hash of every input above; unchanged hash means unchanged card

assetReplaced.description: The file behind this release tag changed after it was first published

assetReplacedDetail.description: How we know it changed: our own earlier copy, or the fingerprint the project's own update manifest gives for this version

updates.description: Where updates come from; a template namespace the developer doesn't control is a concern

check.description: What the update address offers today, e.g. a different file and its label

note.description: What the plugin does to its own updates, e.g. turning Zotero's automatic updates on

partialAnalysis.description: Set when part of the code was skipped or only scanned for known patterns

drivers.description: IDs of the rules that fired (the rule table in pipeline/src/profile/score.ts)

unconfirmed.description: Hosts in this group we found in the code but didn't trace to a request (shown as 'named in its code')

unencrypted.description: Hosts in this group a request reaches over plain http:// (shown as 'unencrypted'): anyone on the network in between can read or change what's sent

observed.description: Hosts in this group the plugin contacted when we ran this exact file in Zotero (shown as 'seen when we ran it'), whether or not we found them in its code; they count as traced requests

legalRisk.description: A destination is a shadow library such as Sci-Hub: shown as a neutral legal notice

drivers.description: IDs of the rules that fired (the rule table in pipeline/src/profile/score.ts)

label.description: Plain language, e.g. 'Writes to the Zotero database directly'

libraries.description: Set when every use sits in bundled libraries: the card names them, e.g. 'from zotero-plugin-toolkit'

detail.description: What, where from or which setting, e.g. 'From astral.sh; not checked against a fixed fingerprint'

drivers.description: IDs of the rules that fired (the rule table in pipeline/src/profile/score.ts)

reviewed.description: False while any requirement is still an unreviewed draft

next.description: Next major on the beta/dev channel, if any

blockedByZotero.description: This version is on Zotero's official plugin blocklist

installProblem.description: Zotero won't install this manifest.json file at all, so it works with no Zotero version: an add-on ID missing or not in the form Firefox accepts (a GUID in braces, or name@domain in letters, digits, - . _), no update address (applications.zotero.update_url) or no maximum version (strict_max_version)

label.description: One line shown next to the overall label: whether it runs on current Zotero

stale.description: A newer version with material changes has appeared since the review

drivers.description: Facets that determined the label, shown next to it

reasons.description: The findings that set the label, most important first: the 'because' line

tested.description: What this exact file did when we ran it in a throwaway Zotero (data/sandbox/<slug>.json); absent when this file hasn't been tested

zotero.description: The Zotero version it ran in

verdict.description: as-described: it loaded, and everything it did beyond what Zotero does by itself is something its card says; unexpected: something it did isn't (the reasons are listed); not-loaded: it didn't start; incomplete: the test didn't finish

readerOpened.description: A PDF was opened in Zotero's reader

settingsPane.description: Zotero's settings opened at the plugin's own pane

menuItems.description: Menu items the plugin added that the test clicked

dialogs.description: Dialogs and prompts the test answered

exercised.description: How much of the plugin the test reached

contacted.description: Hosts it contacted during the test

sentTo.description: Hosts that received the test library's own text during the test, and which kinds, e.g. api.crossref.org: identifiers, titles (the items' DOIs and titles); absent when none did, or when the record doesn't say

items.description: A kind of the test library's own text found in a request: its items' titles, identifiers (DOI, ISBN), authors, abstract, note, the PDF's text, the PDF file itself, tags or collection name

fetched.description: Hosts it only loaded pages from during the test (plain GET or HEAD requests, nothing sent): listed, but not counted as data sharing; absent when there were none, or when the record doesn't say

unexpected.description: What it did that its card didn't say before the test, in plain English

provenance.description: Does the file match its public source? Full details in the release file.

otherServices.description: Other named services the code contacts

storesCredentials.description: Keeps an API key, token or password in settings

localModels.description: Talks to a model or server on this computer

requirementsHints.description: Detected from the code. Not reviewed: enrichment and review confirm them.

kind.description: asset-added: a new build appeared under a release tag we had already seen

asset.description: The build's file name, for asset-added

responses.description: Developers' responses to the card, with our replies (data/plugins/<slug>.yaml)

from.description: GitHub login of a maintainer of the plugin's repository

version.description: The version the response is about

text.description: The developer's words, published as written

url.description: The public issue it came from

status.description: open: we're checking; corrected: the analyzer or rules changed and the card with them; finding-stands: we kept the finding (see reply); noted: context, not a dispute

reply.description: What we checked and what changed, if anything

notices.description: Notices we add to the page by hand
